mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 250 indicates persistent high inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, depressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings visibility, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST > 1300 during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
